fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole boat (1997 Sea Ray 215 Express Cruiser) with trailer.
findings: Bow deck looks dull and chalky with grayish staining across the non-skid and around the forward hatch
Hull sides appear flat rather than glossy, with light scuffing along the starboard side near the dock
Grime and discoloration on the transom and swim platform area in the stern shot
Dirty, scuffed rub rail and hull around the bow in the dock photos
Older photos show the hull on the trailer with a dull finish below the rub rail
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Sea Ray 215. The bow deck and hull sides look a bit dull and stained in the photos, which a gelcoat polish and wax would brighten up nicely before buyers come out. We do pre-sale boat details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
